definition: a thin line used for joining cloth
definitionChinese: 缝合布料时用的细线
narrator: The person with the coat is speaking.

pages.text: The button on my coat is loose.
pages.alt: I look at the loose button on my coat.

pages.text: I put thread through the needle.
pages.alt: I put thread through the needle.

pages.text: The thread joins the button to the cloth.
pages.chinese: 线把纽扣和布连在一起。
pages.alt: The thread joins the button to the cloth.

pages.text: Now the button is fixed. I put the needle in its box.
pages.chinese: 现在纽扣固定好了。我把针收好。
pages.alt: The button is fixed. I put the needle in its box.

check.prompt: Which thing joins cloth in this story?
check.success: Correct. The thin thread goes through the cloth and keeps the button in place.
check.chinese: 故事里是哪种材料把纽扣与布连起来？

practiceExamples: Thread is used to join cloth.

title: A small bag can help
definition: used to put different ideas together
definitionChinese: 连接有对比或转折关系的两句话
narrator: The person with the bag is speaking.

contextSupport.chinese: 这里说袋子结实，能承受重量

pages.text: This bag is small.
pages.alt: I have a small bag and a book.

pages.text: I have a book to carry.
pages.alt: The book is over the open bag.

pages.text: The bag is small, but it is strong.
pages.alt: I put the book in the small bag.

pages.text: It is small, but it can carry what I need.
pages.chinese: 它虽小，但装得下我需要的东西。
pages.alt: The small bag can carry my book.

check.prompt: The bag is old, but it is useful. Can I still use it?
options: No, old things have no use.
check.success: Correct. The sentence says the old bag is still useful.
check.chinese: 袋子虽然旧，但仍有用。我还能用它吗？

practiceExamples: My bag is old, but it is useful.

title: Rain changes my day
definition: used to show what comes after a reason
definitionChinese: 在原因之后引出相应结果
narrator: The person in blue is speaking.

pages.text: I want to go to the garden.
pages.alt: My friend and I want to go to the garden.

pages.text: There is rain, so I am at home.
pages.alt: There is rain. I put my bag back. My friend and I are at home.

semanticText.label: The same reason and effect
lines: There is rain, so I am at home.
I am at home because there is rain.
semanticText.accessibleSummary: Rain is the reason. Being at home is the effect.

pages.text: I am at home, so I can read with my friend.
pages.chinese: 我在家里，所以可以和朋友一起读书。
pages.alt: My friend and I open a book at home.

pages.text: I do not go to the garden. I read at home.
pages.chinese: 我不去花园了。我在家读书。
pages.alt: My friend and I read at home. There is rain.

check.prompt: The cup is empty, so I put water in it. What is the effect?
options: I put water in the cup.
check.success: Correct. The empty cup is the reason. Putting water in it is the effect.
check.chinese: 杯子空了，所以我往里面倒水，结果是哪件事？

practiceExamples: There is rain, so I am at home.

title: Tell me the reason
definition: used to ask for a reason
definitionChinese: 询问一件事的原因，而不是时间或地点
narrator: Li is speaking.
narratorChinese: 回答朋友提问的学习者

pages.text: My friend asks, "Why do you take a bag?"
pages.chinese: 朋友问：“你为什么带袋子？”
pages.alt: My friend asks me why I take a bag.

pages.text: I take it because I want to carry my book.
pages.alt: I put my book in the bag.

pages.text: "Why do you study English?" my friend asks.
pages.chinese: 朋友问：“你为什么学英语？”
pages.alt: My friend asks me a question at the door of a learning room.

pages.text: I study because I want to talk with more persons. What is your reason?
pages.chinese: 我学习，因为我想和更多人交流。你的原因是什么？
pages.alt: I talk with more persons in the learning room.

check.prompt: Why do I carry a cup? I want to drink water. Which answer gives the reason?
options: Because I want to drink water.
check.success: Correct. Why asks for a reason, not a place.
check.chinese: 问“为什么带杯子”，哪种回答提供了原因？

practiceExamples: Why do you study English? Because I want to talk with more persons.

title: A book in a box
definition: to move something so it is not closed
definitionChinese: 打开物体的动作
narrator: The girl in yellow is speaking.

pages.text: My book is in the box.
pages.alt: A girl is at a table with a closed box. Her book is in the box.

pages.text: I open the box.
pages.alt: The girl lifts the box top. A closed green book is in the box.

pages.text: I open the book.
pages.alt: The girl opens the green book on the table. The empty box is near it.

pages.text: Now I can read my book.
pages.alt: The girl looks at pictures in her open book. The empty box is near her.

check.prompt: I open a box. Is the box closed now?
check.success: Correct. The box is open after I open it.
check.chinese: 打开盒子之后，盒子现在关着吗？

practiceExamples: I open the book.
